# Fuzz targets that CI runs, one per line: <package> <target>.
#
# 30 seconds each on every pull request, one hour each nightly. A target
# is listed once the code it exercises survives fuzzing; a finding is
# fixed and its input is committed under the package's testdata/fuzz.
./internal/syntax FuzzParser
./internal/content FuzzScanner
./internal/font FuzzCMap
./internal/file FuzzOpen
./internal/extract FuzzExtract
. FuzzOpen
